court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
facts_of_case: Joint petition for divorce by mutual consent rejected by Family Court due to delay in second motion. Parties want to go their separate ways on mutually agreed terms.

legal_principles.principle: The court may exercise its discretion to waive the statutory waiting period under section 13-B(2) if all conditions are fulfilled.
legal_principles.held: If all the four conditions mentioned above are fulfilled, the court would necessarily have to exercise its discretion to waive the statutory waiting period under Section 13-B(2) of the Marriage Act.
cited_cases: Amardeep Singh vs. Harveen Kaur, (2023) 17 SCC 648
Amit Kumar vs. Suman Beniwal, (2023) 17 SCC 648

legal_principles.principle: The court is obliged to take note of factors mentioned in Amardeep Singh vs. Harveen Kaur, (2023) 17 SCC 648.
legal_principles.held: These are factors which the court is obliged to take note of.
cited_cases: Amardeep Singh vs. Harveen Kaur, (2023) 17 SCC 648
Amit Kumar vs. Suman Beniwal, (2023) 17 SCC 648

legal_principles.principle: The court may grant a decree of divorce by mutual consent on a joint application when the substantive conditions of section 13-B are fulfilled.
legal_principles.held: When the second motion is filed, the court is to make an inquiry, and on satisfaction that the averments made in the petition are true, a decree of divorce is granted.
cited_cases: Shilpa Sailesh vs. Varun Sreenivasan, (2023) 14 SCC 231

legal_principles.principle: The court's power to grant a decree of divorce by mutual consent is not fettered by section 13-B(2) of the Hindu Marriage Act.
legal_principles.held: Section 13-B of the Hindu Marriage Act does not impose any fetters on the powers of this Court to grant a decree of divorce by mutual consent on a joint application, when the substantive conditions of the Section are fulfilled and the Court, after referring to the factors mentioned above, is convinced and of the opinion that the decree of divorce should be granted.
cited_cases: Shilpa Sailesh vs. Varun Sreenivasan, (2023) 14 SCC 231

outcome.final_order: Court allows appeal and grants decree of divorce declaring the marriage dissolved with effect from the date of the decree.

use_for_drafting: drafting a joint petition for divorce
advising on condoning delays in appeals
representing clients in Family Court proceedings
